destinations.best_for: A 2–4 night base split into day trips
destinations.name: Sarandë
destinations.summary: Southern Albania's main base, facing Corfu and minutes from Butrint, Ksamil, the Blue Eye and the Riviera.

destinations.name: Lëkurës Castle
destinations.summary: Hilltop castle with panoramic views over Sarandë, the bay and Corfu — the classic sunset spot.

destinations.name: Ksamil
destinations.summary: Turquoise water and small islands — the classic Albanian beach holiday, busiest in peak summer.

destinations.best_for: Morning visit before the heat, then Ksamil
destinations.name: Butrint
destinations.summary: Major archaeological park and UNESCO World Heritage site: Greek, Roman, Byzantine and Venetian layers in a lagoon forest.

destinations.best_for: Morning stop on the way to Gjirokastër
destinations.name: Blue Eye (Syri i Kaltër)
destinations.summary: A deep natural spring of startling blue in a shady forest — the strongest inland excursion from Sarandë.

destinations.best_for: A slow afternoon of food and wine
destinations.name: Mesopotam & local wineries
destinations.summary: Slower, food-focused excursions: a Byzantine monastery and family wineries in the valley behind Sarandë.

destinations.name: Kakome Bay
destinations.summary: Remote coastal bay with clear water, best approached by boat from Sarandë.

destinations.name: Krorëz Beach
destinations.summary: A secluded white-pebble cove next to Kakome — a remote boat experience.

destinations.name: Bunec & Lukovë
destinations.summary: Quieter coastal options between Borsh and Sarandë — the Riviera without the crowds.

destinations.best_for: A slower beach day with space to spread out
destinations.name: Borsh
destinations.summary: One of the longest beaches on the Riviera, backed by olive groves and a hilltop castle village.

destinations.best_for: A short village walk with coastal panoramas
destinations.name: Qeparo
destinations.summary: Stone village clinging to the hillside with sweeping coastal views.

destinations.best_for: Castle + bay photo stop between Himarë and Borsh
destinations.name: Porto Palermo

destinations.best_for: Families and a relaxed Riviera base
destinations.name: Himarë
destinations.summary: A balanced Riviera base: beaches, restaurants, an old castle town and access to the wider coast.

destinations.name: Gjipe
destinations.summary: A dramatic canyon-mouth bay reached on foot or by boat — adventure with a big reward.

destinations.name: Jalë
destinations.summary: A lively cove with a younger atmosphere and beach bars.

destinations.name: Dhërmi
destinations.summary: Scenic beach below an old hillside village — beach clubs, clear water and mountain backdrops.

destinations.name: Palasë
destinations.summary: Long coastal views and a wide beach just below the Llogara switchbacks.

destinations.name: Llogara Pass
destinations.summary: Mountain-to-sea panorama at 1,000 m where pine forest drops to the Ionian.

destinations.name: Grama Bay
destinations.summary: Wild bay on the Karaburun peninsula with ancient inscriptions carved into the cliffs.

destinations.best_for: A lunch stop between Llogara and Tirana
destinations.name: Vlorë
destinations.summary: Seafront city where the Adriatic meets the Ionian — the gateway between the Riviera and Tirana.

destinations.best_for: Castle, Old Bazaar and stone-house architecture
destinations.name: Gjirokastër
destinations.summary: UNESCO-listed stone city of Ottoman tower houses beneath a vast hilltop castle.

destinations.best_for: A one- or two-night cultural stop between Tirana and the south

destinations.summary: The 'city of a thousand windows': Mangalem and Gorica quarters facing each other beneath a lived-in castle.

destinations.best_for: Optional extension between Berat and Vlorë

destinations.summary: Ancient Greek and Roman city on a quiet hill — worth it if your route continues toward Vlorë.

destinations.best_for: Arrival day and a capital city evening

destinations.summary: Albania's colourful capital: Skanderbeg Square, the Blloku café district and a lively food scene.

destinations.summary: Tirana International Airport Nënë Tereza — the main international gateway.

destinations.name: Durrës
destinations.summary: Port city with a Roman amphitheatre and a long waterfront promenade.

destinations.name: Krujë
destinations.summary: Mountain castle town of Skanderbeg with an old bazaar — an easy cultural stop near Tirana.

destinations.best_for: Rozafa Castle, lake area and old city

destinations.summary: Lakeside cultural city beneath Rozafa Castle — the gateway to the Albanian Alps.

destinations.name: Theth

/essentials.beach_rule: In peak season, arrive early. Carry water, sun protection and a little cash. If you're driving, confirm parking before committing to a beach. For remote beaches, ask locally about road and sea conditions rather than relying on an old social-media post.

beaches.name: Borsh
beaches.note: Good for a slower beach day

/essentials.boat_day: Start in the morning, cruise the coast, swim in 2–3 bays, have lunch by the sea, then return before sunset. Remote places such as Grama Bay are mainly accessible by boat and are best treated as a full excursion.
booking_strategy: Book the first and last nights first, then build the road trip around them.
For July–August, reserve popular coastal accommodation and boat trips early.
Choose accommodation with parking if you are driving.
In beach towns, check whether the quoted room price includes breakfast, parking and taxes.
For archaeological sites and museums, confirm current opening hours and ticket arrangements before your visit.

budget_categories.range: Often €30–€70+ / day depending on season, car and insurance
Highly variable — quote by route and group

budget_tiers.label: Comfort

budget_tiers.label: Premium

checklist: Check the exact sailing date and departure port.
Check whether your ticket is passenger-only or includes a vehicle.
Allow extra time for port check-in and border formalities.
For a same-day Corfu excursion from Sarandë, compare the timetable with the time needed to clear the port on both sides.
corfu.promise: Always check the current operator schedule before booking.
corfu.summary: Corfu and Sarandë are close neighbours across the Ionian Sea, making a combined Greece–Albania holiday very practical. Ferry schedules are seasonal and change, so treat this as a planning framework rather than a timetable.

/essentials.disclaimer: Independent travel-planning guide — not an official government publication. Distances, travel times, prices, opening hours, ferry schedules and business availability can change. Verify current information before booking or travelling.
/essentials.final_check: Before departure: reconfirm accommodation, car rental, ferry / boat tickets, attraction opening times, weather and your travel insurance. Keep a copy of important documents offline.

money: Euros are widely familiar in tourist areas, but don't assume every small business accepts cards or euros.
Keep some lek for cafés, parking, local transport and small purchases.
ATMs are most available in cities and major tourist centres.

Boat day: Dry bag or waterproof phone pouch
Motion-sickness medication if you normally need it
Road trip: Phone charger + car adapter / power bank
Light jacket for evenings / mountain areas

/essentials.price_note: All prices are indicative planning ranges, not fixed 2027 tariffs. Summer accommodation, ferries, beach services, tours and car rental change by date, demand and operator. Always confirm the final price before paying.
quick_start: Recheck ferry schedules, opening times and local prices shortly before travel.
/essentials.restaurant_tip: At a coastal restaurant, ask what fish is fresh that day before choosing from the menu. In busy beach areas, compare the menu and final price before ordering shared seafood platters.
/essentials.road_trip_tip: Don't schedule a major sightseeing attraction at the exact end of a long driving day. Leave a buffer for fuel, photos, coffee, parking and unexpected traffic.

safety.tip: Don't assume every road is fast or predictable; allow extra time on mountain and coastal roads.
In busy coastal centres, confirm where you can legally park before leaving the car.
Boat routes can change because of wind and waves. Follow the captain's instructions.
July and August can be very hot; schedule sightseeing earlier or later in the day.
Keep small notes for cafés, parking and small purchases.
Dress appropriately at religious sites and respect residents in villages.
Carry bottled or trusted drinking water on long road trips.

save_money: Travel in May, June, September or October.
Stay 10–15 minutes outside the busiest beach centre.
Use local bakeries for breakfast or lunch.

seasons.text: Warm weather, strong beach conditions and generally more comfortable sightseeing.
Peak summer: the busiest beaches and strongest demand. Book early and sightsee early or late in the day.
An excellent balance of warm sea, beach weather and sightseeing.
Better for culture, food, hiking and city breaks; many seasonal beach businesses reduce hours.

/hotels/.address: Rruga Gjergj Araniti, Sarandë, Albanian Riviera
/hotels/.description: Our most spacious option — a three-bedroom apartment with sweeping 270° panoramic views of the Albanian Riviera and Corfu Island. Apartment 17 is perfect for larger families or groups who want the comfort of a real home. Two full bathrooms, a generous living space, and a private terrace to enjoy the Ionian sunsets.

de.description: Unsere geräumigste Unterkunft — ein Apartment mit drei Schlafzimmern und weitem 270°-Panoramablick auf die Albanische Riviera und die Insel Korfu. Apartment 17 ist ideal für größere Familien oder Gruppen, die den Komfort eines echten Zuhauses suchen. Zwei vollwertige Bäder, ein großzügiger Wohnbereich und eine private Terrasse für die Sonnenuntergänge am Ionischen Meer.

fr.description: Notre logement le plus spacieux — un appartement de trois chambres avec une vue panoramique à 270° sur la Riviera albanaise et l'île de Corfou. L'appartement 17 convient parfaitement aux grandes familles ou aux groupes qui veulent le confort d'une vraie maison. Deux salles de bain complètes, un séjour généreux et une terrasse privée pour profiter des couchers de soleil sur la mer Ionienne.

it.description: La nostra soluzione più spaziosa — un appartamento con tre camere da letto e un'ampia vista panoramica a 270° sulla Riviera albanese e sull'isola di Corfù. L'appartamento 17 è perfetto per famiglie numerose o gruppi che cercano il comfort di una vera casa. Due bagni completi, un soggiorno generoso e una terrazza privata per godersi i tramonti sullo Ionio.

sq.description: Mundësia jonë më e gjerë — apartament me tri dhoma gjumi dhe pamje panoramike 270° nga Riviera Shqiptare dhe ishulli i Korfuzit. Apartamenti 17 është i përkryer për familje të mëdha ose grupe që duan rehatinë e një shtëpie të vërtetë. Dy banja të plota, hapësirë e bollshme ndenjeje dhe tarracë private për të shijuar perëndimet e Jonit.

/hotels/.address: Rruga Gjergj Araniti, Sarandë, Albanian Riviera
/hotels/.description: Wake up to stunning Ionian Sea views in this bright, well-equipped studio. Apartment 4 features a private balcony overlooking Sarandë Bay, a modern kitchen, and everything you need for a perfect getaway. Just steps from the promenade and local restaurants.

de.description: Wachen Sie in diesem hellen, gut ausgestatteten Studio mit herrlichem Blick auf das Ionische Meer auf. Apartment 4 bietet einen privaten Balkon mit Blick über die Bucht von Saranda, eine moderne Küche und alles, was Sie für einen gelungenen Urlaub brauchen. Nur wenige Schritte von der Promenade und den Restaurants entfernt.

fr.description: Réveillez-vous face à la mer Ionienne dans ce studio lumineux et bien équipé. L'appartement 4 dispose d'un balcon privé donnant sur la baie de Sarandë, d'une cuisine moderne et de tout le nécessaire pour un séjour parfait. À quelques pas de la promenade et des restaurants.

it.description: Svegliatevi con una splendida vista sul Mar Ionio in questo monolocale luminoso e ben attrezzato. L'appartamento 4 ha un balcone privato affacciato sulla baia di Saranda, una cucina moderna e tutto il necessario per una vacanza perfetta. A pochi passi dal lungomare e dai ristoranti.

sq.description: Zgjohuni me pamje mahnitëse nga Deti Jon në këtë studio të ndritshme e të pajisur mirë. Apartamenti 4 ka ballkon privat me pamje nga gjiri i Sarandës, kuzhinë moderne dhe gjithçka që ju duhet për pushime të përkryera. Vetëm pak hapa nga shëtitorja dhe restorantet vendase.

/hotels/.address: Rruga Gjergj Araniti, Sarandë, Albanian Riviera
/hotels/.description: Designed for romance and relaxation, Apartment 23 faces west to capture Sarandë's legendary golden sunsets over the Ionian Sea. The cozy studio layout features a queen bed, a kitchenette, and a curtained window seat perfect for watching the sun dip below the horizon. An ideal escape for couples.

de.description: Für Romantik und Entspannung gemacht: Apartment 23 liegt nach Westen und fängt Sarandas legendäre goldene Sonnenuntergänge über dem Ionischen Meer ein. Das gemütliche Studio hat ein Queensize-Bett, eine Kitchenette und eine Fensterbank mit Vorhang — ideal, um der Sonne beim Versinken am Horizont zuzusehen. Ein perfekter Rückzugsort für Paare.

fr.description: Pensé pour le romantisme et la détente, l'appartement 23 est orienté à l'ouest pour saisir les légendaires couchers de soleil dorés de Sarandë sur la mer Ionienne. Ce studio chaleureux comprend un grand lit, une kitchenette et une banquette de fenêtre avec rideaux, idéale pour regarder le soleil glisser sous l'horizon. Une escapade parfaite pour les couples.

it.description: Pensato per il romanticismo e il relax, l'appartamento 23 è rivolto a ovest per cogliere i leggendari tramonti dorati di Saranda sul Mar Ionio. L'accogliente monolocale ha un letto matrimoniale, un angolo cottura e una seduta sotto la finestra con tende, perfetta per guardare il sole scendere all'orizzonte. Una fuga ideale per le coppie.

sq.description: I menduar për romancë dhe qetësi, Apartamenti 23 sheh nga perëndimi për të kapur perëndimet e arta legjendare të Sarandës mbi Detin Jon. Studioja e ngrohtë ka shtrat dopio, kuzhinë të vogël dhe një ndenjëse pranë dritares me perde, e përkryer për të parë diellin teksa zhytet në horizont. Arratisje ideale për çifte.

/hotels/.address: Rruga Gjergj Araniti, Sarandë, Albanian Riviera
/hotels/.description: Spacious two-bedroom apartment ideal for families and groups. Apartment 11 offers two comfortable bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, a large living area with a Smart TV, and direct views of the Ionian coast. Located in the heart of Sarandë, close to beaches, restaurants, and activities.

de.description: Geräumiges Apartment mit zwei Schlafzimmern, ideal für Familien und Gruppen. Apartment 11 bietet zwei komfortable Schlafzimmer, eine voll ausgestattete Küche, einen großen Wohnbereich mit Smart-TV und direkten Blick auf die ionische Küste. Im Herzen von Saranda gelegen, nahe an Stränden, Restaurants und Aktivitäten.

fr.description: Spacieux appartement de deux chambres, idéal pour les familles et les groupes. L'appartement 11 offre deux chambres confortables, une cuisine entièrement équipée, un grand séjour avec Smart TV et une vue directe sur la côte ionienne. Au cœur de Sarandë, près des plages, des restaurants et des activités.

it.description: Spazioso appartamento con due camere da letto, ideale per famiglie e gruppi. L'appartamento 11 offre due camere confortevoli, una cucina completamente attrezzata, un ampio soggiorno con Smart TV e vista diretta sulla costa ionica. Nel cuore di Saranda, vicino a spiagge, ristoranti e attività.

sq.description: Apartament i gjerë me dy dhoma gjumi, ideal për familje dhe grupe. Apartamenti 11 ofron dy dhoma gjumi të rehatshme, kuzhinë të pajisur plotësisht, një ambient të madh ndenjeje me Smart TV dhe pamje të drejtpërdrejtë nga bregu i Jonit. Ndodhet në zemër të Sarandës, pranë plazheve, restoranteve dhe aktiviteteve.

/hotels/.address: Rruga Gjergj Araniti, Sarandë, Albanian Riviera
/hotels/.description: Our top-rated apartment on Booking.com — rated Wonderful 9.2/10 by verified guests. This two-bedroom gem features a fully equipped kitchen, a bright living room, and beautiful sea views. Scored top marks for cleanliness, location, and host responsiveness. Perfect for families or a group of friends seeking a premium Sarandë experience.

de.description: Unser bestbewertetes Apartment auf Booking.com — von verifizierten Gästen mit „Hervorragend“ 9.2/10 bewertet. Dieses Schmuckstück mit zwei Schlafzimmern bietet eine voll ausgestattete Küche, ein helles Wohnzimmer und schönen Meerblick. Bestnoten für Sauberkeit, Lage und Erreichbarkeit des Gastgebers. Ideal für Familien oder eine Gruppe von Freunden, die in Saranda einen hochwertigen Aufenthalt suchen.

fr.description: Notre appartement le mieux noté sur Booking.com — « Fabuleux » 9.2/10 selon des voyageurs vérifiés. Ce bijou de deux chambres dispose d'une cuisine entièrement équipée, d'un séjour lumineux et d'une belle vue sur la mer. Il obtient les meilleures notes pour la propreté, l'emplacement et la réactivité de l'hôte. Parfait pour les familles ou un groupe d'amis en quête d'un séjour haut de gamme à Sarandë.

it.description: Il nostro appartamento più votato su Booking.com — «Eccellente» 9.2/10 secondo ospiti verificati. Questo gioiello con due camere da letto offre una cucina completamente attrezzata, un soggiorno luminoso e una bella vista sul mare. Ha ottenuto i punteggi più alti per pulizia, posizione e disponibilità dell'host. Perfetto per famiglie o per un gruppo di amici che cercano un soggiorno di alto livello a Saranda.

sq.description: Apartamenti ynë më i vlerësuar në Booking.com — me vlerësimin «I mrekullueshëm» 9.2/10 nga mysafirë të verifikuar. Ky apartament me dy dhoma gjumi ka kuzhinë të pajisur plotësisht, dhomë ndenjeje të ndritshme dhe pamje të bukur nga deti. Ka marrë notat më të larta për pastërtinë, vendndodhjen dhe gatishmërinë e mikpritësit. I përkryer për familje ose një grup miqsh që kërkojnë një përvojë cilësore në Sarandë.

/hotels/3.address: Rruga Gjergj Araniti, Sarandë, Albanian Riviera
/hotels/3.description: Our most spacious option — a three-bedroom apartment with sweeping 270° panoramic views of the Albanian Riviera and Corfu Island. Apartment 17 is perfect for larger families or groups who want the comfort of a real home. Two full bathrooms, a generous living space, and a private terrace to enjoy the Ionian sunsets.

de.description: Unsere geräumigste Unterkunft — ein Apartment mit drei Schlafzimmern und weitem 270°-Panoramablick auf die Albanische Riviera und die Insel Korfu. Apartment 17 ist ideal für größere Familien oder Gruppen, die den Komfort eines echten Zuhauses suchen. Zwei vollwertige Bäder, ein großzügiger Wohnbereich und eine private Terrasse für die Sonnenuntergänge am Ionischen Meer.

fr.description: Notre logement le plus spacieux — un appartement de trois chambres avec une vue panoramique à 270° sur la Riviera albanaise et l'île de Corfou. L'appartement 17 convient parfaitement aux grandes familles ou aux groupes qui veulent le confort d'une vraie maison. Deux salles de bain complètes, un séjour généreux et une terrasse privée pour profiter des couchers de soleil sur la mer Ionienne.

it.description: La nostra soluzione più spaziosa — un appartamento con tre camere da letto e un'ampia vista panoramica a 270° sulla Riviera albanese e sull'isola di Corfù. L'appartamento 17 è perfetto per famiglie numerose o gruppi che cercano il comfort di una vera casa. Due bagni completi, un soggiorno generoso e una terrazza privata per godersi i tramonti sullo Ionio.

sq.description: Mundësia jonë më e gjerë — apartament me tri dhoma gjumi dhe pamje panoramike 270° nga Riviera Shqiptare dhe ishulli i Korfuzit. Apartamenti 17 është i përkryer për familje të mëdha ose grupe që duan rehatinë e një shtëpie të vërtetë. Dy banja të plota, hapësirë e bollshme ndenjeje dhe tarracë private për të shijuar perëndimet e Jonit.

/hotels/1.address: Rruga Gjergj Araniti, Sarandë, Albanian Riviera
/hotels/1.description: Wake up to stunning Ionian Sea views in this bright, well-equipped studio. Apartment 4 features a private balcony overlooking Sarandë Bay, a modern kitchen, and everything you need for a perfect getaway. Just steps from the promenade and local restaurants.

de.description: Wachen Sie in diesem hellen, gut ausgestatteten Studio mit herrlichem Blick auf das Ionische Meer auf. Apartment 4 bietet einen privaten Balkon mit Blick über die Bucht von Saranda, eine moderne Küche und alles, was Sie für einen gelungenen Urlaub brauchen. Nur wenige Schritte von der Promenade und den Restaurants entfernt.

fr.description: Réveillez-vous face à la mer Ionienne dans ce studio lumineux et bien équipé. L'appartement 4 dispose d'un balcon privé donnant sur la baie de Sarandë, d'une cuisine moderne et de tout le nécessaire pour un séjour parfait. À quelques pas de la promenade et des restaurants.

it.description: Svegliatevi con una splendida vista sul Mar Ionio in questo monolocale luminoso e ben attrezzato. L'appartamento 4 ha un balcone privato affacciato sulla baia di Saranda, una cucina moderna e tutto il necessario per una vacanza perfetta. A pochi passi dal lungomare e dai ristoranti.

sq.description: Zgjohuni me pamje mahnitëse nga Deti Jon në këtë studio të ndritshme e të pajisur mirë. Apartamenti 4 ka ballkon privat me pamje nga gjiri i Sarandës, kuzhinë moderne dhe gjithçka që ju duhet për pushime të përkryera. Vetëm pak hapa nga shëtitorja dhe restorantet vendase.

/hotels/4.address: Rruga Gjergj Araniti, Sarandë, Albanian Riviera
/hotels/4.description: Designed for romance and relaxation, Apartment 23 faces west to capture Sarandë's legendary golden sunsets over the Ionian Sea. The cozy studio layout features a queen bed, a kitchenette, and a curtained window seat perfect for watching the sun dip below the horizon. An ideal escape for couples.

de.description: Für Romantik und Entspannung gemacht: Apartment 23 liegt nach Westen und fängt Sarandas legendäre goldene Sonnenuntergänge über dem Ionischen Meer ein. Das gemütliche Studio hat ein Queensize-Bett, eine Kitchenette und eine Fensterbank mit Vorhang — ideal, um der Sonne beim Versinken am Horizont zuzusehen. Ein perfekter Rückzugsort für Paare.

fr.description: Pensé pour le romantisme et la détente, l'appartement 23 est orienté à l'ouest pour saisir les légendaires couchers de soleil dorés de Sarandë sur la mer Ionienne. Ce studio chaleureux comprend un grand lit, une kitchenette et une banquette de fenêtre avec rideaux, idéale pour regarder le soleil glisser sous l'horizon. Une escapade parfaite pour les couples.

it.description: Pensato per il romanticismo e il relax, l'appartamento 23 è rivolto a ovest per cogliere i leggendari tramonti dorati di Saranda sul Mar Ionio. L'accogliente monolocale ha un letto matrimoniale, un angolo cottura e una seduta sotto la finestra con tende, perfetta per guardare il sole scendere all'orizzonte. Una fuga ideale per le coppie.

sq.description: I menduar për romancë dhe qetësi, Apartamenti 23 sheh nga perëndimi për të kapur perëndimet e arta legjendare të Sarandës mbi Detin Jon. Studioja e ngrohtë ka shtrat dopio, kuzhinë të vogël dhe një ndenjëse pranë dritares me perde, e përkryer për të parë diellin teksa zhytet në horizont. Arratisje ideale për çifte.

/hotels/2.address: Rruga Gjergj Araniti, Sarandë, Albanian Riviera
/hotels/2.description: Spacious two-bedroom apartment ideal for families and groups. Apartment 11 offers two comfortable bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, a large living area with a Smart TV, and direct views of the Ionian coast. Located in the heart of Sarandë, close to beaches, restaurants, and activities.

de.description: Geräumiges Apartment mit zwei Schlafzimmern, ideal für Familien und Gruppen. Apartment 11 bietet zwei komfortable Schlafzimmer, eine voll ausgestattete Küche, einen großen Wohnbereich mit Smart-TV und direkten Blick auf die ionische Küste. Im Herzen von Saranda gelegen, nahe an Stränden, Restaurants und Aktivitäten.

fr.description: Spacieux appartement de deux chambres, idéal pour les familles et les groupes. L'appartement 11 offre deux chambres confortables, une cuisine entièrement équipée, un grand séjour avec Smart TV et une vue directe sur la côte ionienne. Au cœur de Sarandë, près des plages, des restaurants et des activités.

it.description: Spazioso appartamento con due camere da letto, ideale per famiglie e gruppi. L'appartamento 11 offre due camere confortevoli, una cucina completamente attrezzata, un ampio soggiorno con Smart TV e vista diretta sulla costa ionica. Nel cuore di Saranda, vicino a spiagge, ristoranti e attività.

sq.description: Apartament i gjerë me dy dhoma gjumi, ideal për familje dhe grupe. Apartamenti 11 ofron dy dhoma gjumi të rehatshme, kuzhinë të pajisur plotësisht, një ambient të madh ndenjeje me Smart TV dhe pamje të drejtpërdrejtë nga bregu i Jonit. Ndodhet në zemër të Sarandës, pranë plazheve, restoranteve dhe aktiviteteve.

/hotels/5.address: Rruga Gjergj Araniti, Sarandë, Albanian Riviera
/hotels/5.description: Our top-rated apartment on Booking.com — rated Wonderful 9.2/10 by verified guests. This two-bedroom gem features a fully equipped kitchen, a bright living room, and beautiful sea views. Scored top marks for cleanliness, location, and host responsiveness. Perfect for families or a group of friends seeking a premium Sarandë experience.

de.description: Unser bestbewertetes Apartment auf Booking.com — von verifizierten Gästen mit „Hervorragend“ 9.2/10 bewertet. Dieses Schmuckstück mit zwei Schlafzimmern bietet eine voll ausgestattete Küche, ein helles Wohnzimmer und schönen Meerblick. Bestnoten für Sauberkeit, Lage und Erreichbarkeit des Gastgebers. Ideal für Familien oder eine Gruppe von Freunden, die in Saranda einen hochwertigen Aufenthalt suchen.

fr.description: Notre appartement le mieux noté sur Booking.com — « Fabuleux » 9.2/10 selon des voyageurs vérifiés. Ce bijou de deux chambres dispose d'une cuisine entièrement équipée, d'un séjour lumineux et d'une belle vue sur la mer. Il obtient les meilleures notes pour la propreté, l'emplacement et la réactivité de l'hôte. Parfait pour les familles ou un groupe d'amis en quête d'un séjour haut de gamme à Sarandë.

it.description: Il nostro appartamento più votato su Booking.com — «Eccellente» 9.2/10 secondo ospiti verificati. Questo gioiello con due camere da letto offre una cucina completamente attrezzata, un soggiorno luminoso e una bella vista sul mare. Ha ottenuto i punteggi più alti per pulizia, posizione e disponibilità dell'host. Perfetto per famiglie o per un gruppo di amici che cercano un soggiorno di alto livello a Saranda.

sq.description: Apartamenti ynë më i vlerësuar në Booking.com — me vlerësimin «I mrekullueshëm» 9.2/10 nga mysafirë të verifikuar. Ky apartament me dy dhoma gjumi ka kuzhinë të pajisur plotësisht, dhomë ndenjeje të ndritshme dhe pamje të bukur nga deti. Ka marrë notat më të larta për pastërtinë, vendndodhjen dhe gatishmërinë e mikpritësit. I përkryer për familje ose një grup miqsh që kërkojnë një përvojë cilësore në Sarandë.

destinations.name: Sarandë
destinations.summary: Southern Albania's main base, facing Corfu and minutes from Butrint, Ksamil, the Blue Eye and the Riviera.
destinations.best_for: A 2–4 night base split into day trips
destinations.planning_note: Don't try to see everything in one afternoon. Use Sarandë as a base and split the area into 2–4 day trips.

destinations.name: Lëkurës Castle
destinations.summary: Hilltop castle with panoramic views over Sarandë, the bay and Corfu — the classic sunset spot.

destinations.name: Ksamil
destinations.summary: Turquoise water and small islands — the classic Albanian beach holiday, busiest in peak summer.
destinations.planning_note: Very busy in July–August. Arrive early, bring cash and confirm parking before committing.
highlights: Ksamil islands by pedal boat or water taxi

destinations.name: Butrint
destinations.summary: Major archaeological park and UNESCO World Heritage site: Greek, Roman, Byzantine and Venetian layers in a lagoon forest.
destinations.best_for: Morning visit before the heat, then Ksamil
destinations.planning_note: Confirm current opening hours and ticket arrangements before your visit.

destinations.name: Blue Eye (Syri i Kaltër)
destinations.summary: A deep natural spring of startling blue in a shady forest — the strongest inland excursion from Sarandë.
destinations.best_for: Morning stop on the way to Gjirokastër
destinations.planning_note: Allow roughly 1–2 hours. Wear comfortable shoes — don't plan it as a quick roadside photo stop.

destinations.name: Mesopotam & local wineries
destinations.summary: Slower, food-focused excursions: a Byzantine monastery and family wineries in the valley behind Sarandë.
destinations.best_for: A slow afternoon of food and wine

destinations.name: Kakome Bay
destinations.summary: Remote coastal bay with clear water, best approached by boat from Sarandë.
destinations.planning_note: Boat-dependent. Sea conditions can change routes — follow the captain.

destinations.name: Krorëz Beach
destinations.summary: A secluded white-pebble cove next to Kakome — a remote boat experience.
destinations.planning_note: Boat-dependent; bring water, shade and essentials.

destinations.name: Bunec & Lukovë
destinations.summary: Quieter coastal options between Borsh and Sarandë — the Riviera without the crowds.

destinations.name: Borsh
destinations.summary: One of the longest beaches on the Riviera, backed by olive groves and a hilltop castle village.
destinations.best_for: A slower beach day with space to spread out

destinations.name: Qeparo
destinations.summary: Stone village clinging to the hillside with sweeping coastal views.
destinations.best_for: A short village walk with coastal panoramas

destinations.name: Porto Palermo
destinations.summary: A triangular fortress on a small peninsula inside a spectacular sheltered bay.
destinations.best_for: Castle + bay photo stop between Himarë and Borsh

destinations.name: Himarë
destinations.summary: A balanced Riviera base: beaches, restaurants, an old castle town and access to the wider coast.
destinations.best_for: Families and a relaxed Riviera base
destinations.planning_note: Himarë Beach has easy access and restaurants — a good base for families.

destinations.name: Gjipe
destinations.summary: A dramatic canyon-mouth bay reached on foot or by boat — adventure with a big reward.
destinations.planning_note: Access depends on route or boat — allow extra time and carry water.

destinations.name: Jalë
destinations.summary: A lively cove with a younger atmosphere and beach bars.
destinations.planning_note: Check seasonal opening before you go.

destinations.name: Dhërmi
destinations.summary: Scenic beach below an old hillside village — beach clubs, clear water and mountain backdrops.

destinations.name: Palasë
destinations.summary: Long coastal views and a wide beach just below the Llogara switchbacks.

destinations.name: Llogara Pass
destinations.summary: Mountain-to-sea panorama at 1,000 m where pine forest drops to the Ionian.
destinations.planning_note: Mountain road — allow extra time and bring a light jacket.

destinations.name: Grama Bay
destinations.summary: Wild bay on the Karaburun peninsula with ancient inscriptions carved into the cliffs.
destinations.planning_note: Mainly boat access — treat it as a full excursion, not a quick stop.

destinations.name: Vlorë
destinations.summary: Seafront city where the Adriatic meets the Ionian — the gateway between the Riviera and Tirana.
destinations.best_for: A lunch stop between Llogara and Tirana

destinations.name: Gjirokastër
destinations.summary: UNESCO-listed stone city of Ottoman tower houses beneath a vast hilltop castle.
destinations.best_for: Castle, Old Bazaar and stone-house architecture
destinations.planning_note: Castle: allow 1.5–2.5 hours. The Old Bazaar is ideal for a late-afternoon walk.

destinations.name: Berat
destinations.summary: The 'city of a thousand windows': Mangalem and Gorica quarters facing each other beneath a lived-in castle.
destinations.best_for: A one- or two-night cultural stop between Tirana and the south
destinations.planning_note: One of the easiest cultural destinations to explore on foot.

destinations.name: Apollonia
destinations.summary: Ancient Greek and Roman city on a quiet hill — worth it if your route continues toward Vlorë.
destinations.best_for: Optional extension between Berat and Vlorë

destinations.name: Tirana
destinations.summary: Albania's colourful capital: Skanderbeg Square, the Blloku café district and a lively food scene.
destinations.best_for: Arrival day and a capital city evening

destinations.name: Tirana Airport (TIA)
destinations.summary: Tirana International Airport Nënë Tereza — the main international gateway.

destinations.name: Durrës
destinations.summary: Port city with a Roman amphitheatre and a long waterfront promenade.

destinations.name: Krujë
destinations.summary: Mountain castle town of Skanderbeg with an old bazaar — an easy cultural stop near Tirana.

destinations.name: Shkodër
destinations.summary: Lakeside cultural city beneath Rozafa Castle — the gateway to the Albanian Alps.
destinations.best_for: Rozafa Castle, lake area and old city

destinations.name: Theth
destinations.summary: Remote mountain village in the Accursed Mountains with waterfalls and dramatic peaks.
destinations.planning_note: Village walk / waterfall if conditions allow. Mountain road — check conditions and season.

destinations.name: Corfu Town (Greece)
destinations.summary: Venetian old town across the channel — combine a Greece–Albania holiday via the Sarandë ferry.
destinations.planning_note: Ferry schedules are seasonal — always check the current operator timetable before booking.

saranda.name: Sarandë & Ksamil
saranda.blurb: The southern base opposite Corfu: Butrint, Ksamil islands, the Blue Eye.

riviera.name: Albanian Riviera
riviera.blurb: Himarë to Llogara: villages, viewpoints, bays and boat-only beaches.

inland-south.name: Gjirokastër & the Blue Eye
inland-south.blurb: Stone-city UNESCO heritage paired with a natural spring.

central.name: Berat & Central Albania
central.blurb: Ottoman quarters, castles, wineries and ancient Apollonia.

capital.name: Tirana & the Coast
capital.blurb: The capital, Durrës waterfront and Krujë's mountain bazaar.

north.name: Shkodër & the Alps
north.blurb: Lake Shkodër, Rozafa Castle and the high valley of Theth.

greece.name: Corfu (Greece)
greece.blurb: Across the channel: combine Greece and Albania in one trip.

data.road_trip_tip: Don't schedule a major sightseeing attraction at the exact end of a long driving day. Leave a buffer for fuel, photos, coffee, parking and unexpected traffic.
save_money: Travel in May, June, September or October.
Stay 10–15 minutes outside the busiest beach centre.
Use local bakeries for breakfast or lunch.
